protected_invariant: Unaccepted, unlabelled, unvalidated or otherwise uncontrolled prose artifacts are prohibited under data/book.
reasoning: The historical zero-prose assertion correctly detected the first authorised state change. Architecture V2 Pilot #2 produced one immutable draft after an accepted gate and validator result. Keeping an absolute zero-file assertion would now encode a false state fact; permitting arbitrary Markdown would discard the protection. The assertion is therefore re-scoped to one exact, hash-bound, manifest-attested pilot artifact.
extension_rule: Every Markdown artifact under data/book must be named above and must satisfy all recorded attestations. No other prose extension is permitted.
future_change_rule: A future prose artifact requires a new versioned contract decision; this named exception must not be copied or generalized.
